EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

1. POSITION AND DUTIES: The Employee shall serve as Senior Software Engineer. The Employee shall perform all duties and responsibilities assigned by the Employer.
2. AT-WILL EMPLOYMENT: The employment relationship is "at-will." Either the Employer or the Employee may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice.
3. COMPENSATION: The Employer shall pay the Employee a base salary of $150,000 per year, payable in accordance with the Employer's standard payroll schedule.
4. NON-COMPETE: During the term of employment and for a period of twelve (12) months following termination, the Employee shall not engage in any business that competes directly with the Employer within the United States.
5. NON-SOLICITATION: For a period of twelve (12) months following termination, the Employee shall not solicit any employee, customer, or client of the Employer.
6. CONFIDENTIALITY: The Employee agrees to maintain the confidentiality of all proprietary business information and trade secrets of the Employer, both during and after employment.
7. GOVERNING LAW: This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
